desc:
You're in Tornado Blox when suddenly you see a tornado twisting towards you at max speed. You jump in your Tornado Chasing Vehicle and try to get the best view you can of the cyclone. In this game you can observe tornados and study tornadoes. Many storms can spawn and every single one will unleash a beast ready to devastate Tornado Blox. 

TAGS: tornado, ef4, ef5, tornado chasing, chasing, driving, probe, camera, survival, suburban, neighborhood, twister, cyclone

Check out my group!  https://www.roblox.com/groups/34518233/Tornado-Blox-Community#!/about

Play the original Tornado Blox here: https://www.roblox.com/games/118773927543454/Tornado-Blox-OG

Important: Our vehicle models are not ours, they are free models except for some edits. Our houses, structures, tornadoes, and everything else besides our vehicles, we have a right to claim.
